grades.quote: When this bit is 1, accessing any implemented performance counter PCNT with the CSRRD instruction at the PLV3 privilege level does not trigger an instruction privilege level error exception (IPE).
grades.reason: This LoongArch MISC register passage shows that the instruction privilege level error exception (IPE) is the exception raised when a privilege level, such as PLV3 user level, uses CSRRD on a performance counter it is not permitted to access. The bit being 1 suppresses IPE. This supports IPE as the privilege-violation exception, but only for one specific case.
